|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters (V)]]; it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip, which prints it (so does the Players Committee card image); the release-sheet slip shows the original text (see [[Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; this copy was re-made on 25 July 2011, after the errata of 23 June 2011; the first printing has not been found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: Dark Side “While Insidious Prisoner on table, Cyborg Commander is immune to attrition.”; Light Side “Force drain -1 here . Jedi here may not have their power reduced.” (with the space before the period, as printed). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p4-95-Coruscant_Palpatines_Quarters.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list (2012–13) shows no game text for this location.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) names Grievous instead of Cyborg Commander on the Dark Side<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: Dark Side “While Insidious Prisoner on table, Grievous is immune to attrition.”; Light Side “Force drain -1 here. Jedi here may not have their power reduced.” (the Light Side text is unchanged apart from the space). The Players Committee had announced the persona change “Cyborg Commander ---&gt; Grievous” on 29 January 2013.<ref name="persona-2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013 (“Cyborg Commander ---&gt; Grievous”). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-17-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-coruscantpalpatinesquarters-pre.gif]]) print it.
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters (V)]].
